blocks.html:
Why get a truck wrap to promote your business?

Trucks are large vehicles that are almost impossible to ignore when they drive by. Their huge build and the fact that it’s a vehicle that will travel around places make them a perfect canvas to advertise your business. Trucks often have enough real estate for you to go wild with your imagination on how you can advertise your business.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto has highly skilled graphic designers and professional installers, who will help you bring your vision to life. We follow a structured process that entirely revolves around the client’s marketing vision.

This full truck wrap was completed for a returning client, Rockbottom Underpinning. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has either wrapped or added decals to each one of the companies’ vehicles. The owner of the business understands the power of the moving billboards his vehicles represent. Follow this link to view another full van wrap we did for Rockbottom.

The installation process begins only when the design has been approved by the client. Our team will walk you through the materials we use and the difference between each type of material we recommend. Our Expert installers will also answer any other queries that you may have about the whole process at any time. We don’t expect our clients to know the ins and outs of wrapping vehicles, that’s what we’re here for.

We encourage all potential clients to reach out to us and discuss their requirements with us in order to provide an appropriate quote. If you wish to advertise your business on your vehicle, or just want to get a truck wrap, we’d love for you to call us at 416-746-1381. To give you the best service, pay us a visit, and we make the magic happen, 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1 Etobicoke, ON M9W 1B4 is the address.

Our team holds mastery in getting these things done. Full or Partial custom-designed truck wrap, lettering and decals, equipment wrap, signage, and storefront wraps, wall wraps. Basically, the ability to wrap anything which can be wrapped. So, just give us a call if you’ve got something that could use a little Vinyl Goodness!
